articles.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - iRhythm Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: IRTC), a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease, today announced that on November 10, 2026, its Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program with authorization to purchase up to $200 million of the company’s outstanding common stock. The approval reflects iRhythm’s confidence in the continued strength of its core business, as well as its significant new growth opportunities from the addition of the recently acquired VitalConnect business. Repurchases under the program may be made in the open market, in privately negotiated transactions, through accelerated share repurchase transactions or by other methods, with the amount and timing of repurchases to be determined at the company’s discretion, depending on market conditions and corporate needs.
